_comment: TikTok browser-automation posting settings. Cookies come from exporting your logged-in browser session (Netscape format) to data/cookies.txt - see scripts/setup.ps1 step 6. headless: TikTok's bot detection is stricter; keep false for reliable posting. upload_timeout_sec: seconds allowed for page loads during upload (homepage/auth + upload page); raise it if the heavy TikTok pages load slowly. user_agent: keep this a recent desktop Chrome UA - the library default (Chrome 58) gets connection-reset by TikTok's WAF. retry_wait_*: exponential backoff applied between upload attempts after each failure. backend: 'browser' (default, Playwright + cookies) or 'api' (official Content Posting API - set TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY/TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET in .env, register redirect URI http://localhost:*/callback/ on your TikTok app, then run ttclips-upload --auth once). api.api_mode: 'inbox' (draft lands in your TikTok inbox, you tap publish - no audit needed) or 'direct' (posts straight away; unaudited apps can only post SELF_ONLY to a private account). api.privacy_level: optional override (PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE|MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS|FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR|SELF_ONLY); default follows visibility, and falls back to SELF_ONLY if the account does not allow it. AI-generated clips are labelled is_aigc automatically in direct mode.
